new_destinations.name: Mildura
new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage page "Mildura" (the counted source for Lock 11, Meeting of the Waters and the town); Visit Mildura / Explore Mildura tourism brand; the Sunraysia regional centre.
new_destinations.reason: 4 kept spots within ~22 km (Lock 11, Apex Park, Botanic Gardens, Meeting of the Waters at Wentworth) plus 3 existing Wentworth spots proposed to move in. Town itself is the destination, not a spot.

new_destinations.name: Echuca
new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage page "Echuca" (counted source for Port of Echuca and the Echuca-Moama twin towns); paddle steamer/Port of Echuca headline attraction named for it; Victorian side only.
new_destinations.reason: 5 kept spots within ~47 km (Port of Echuca, Barmah NP, Dharnya Centre, Kyabram Fauna Park, Terrick Terrick NP); span 80 km gives ~60 km reach. Echuca-Moama candidate is the destination, not a spot.

places.name: Lock 11
places.bio_draft: Murray lock and weir with Lock Island walking tracks and sandbars, where paddle steamers lock through at Mildura.
places.reason: Wikivoyage Mildura plus exploremildura/Mildura council: the only Murray lock the public can walk across, island lookout over the weir; short but a named second-tier stop.

places.name: Meeting of the Waters
places.coordinates_source: none yet: pin needed from a named visitor point (resolve-pin.py)
places.bio_draft: Riverside park viewpoint at Wentworth where the Murray and Darling rivers meet, about 20 km west of Mildura.
places.reason: Lonely Planet, Visit NSW and Wikivoyage Wentworth name the Murray-Darling junction with a viewing tower and Junction Island walk; two counted sources, a named natural landmark.
places.wiki_candidate: Confluence of the Murray and Darling rivers

places.name: Australian Inland Botanic Gardens
places.bio_draft: Semi-arid botanic gardens at Buronga, near Mildura, with plants from every inhabited continent and native species.
places.reason: Wikivoyage Mildura plus Visit Mildura map list the free semi-arid botanic garden with cafe; half an hour or more to walk.

places.name: Apex Park
places.bio_draft: Riverside park on the Murray at Mildura with a sandbar swimming beach, sometimes patrolled.
places.reason: Wikivoyage Mildura names it a large inland sandbar beach for swimming; Visit Mildura links it to the Chaffey Trail; a beach stop (rule: second-tier beaches keep). Objection: seasonal swimming only.

places.name: Port of Echuca
places.coordinates_source: none yet: pin needed from a named visitor point (resolve-pin.py)
places.bio_draft: Historic 1800s river port with its wharf, paddle steamer boarding and the Discovery Centre at Echuca.
places.reason: Wikivoyage Echuca names the historic wharf, paddle steamers and Discovery Centre; headline attraction of the region.

places.name: Barmah National Park
places.bio_draft: River red gum forest on the Murray floodplain with Barmah Lakes, birdwatching, paddling, fishing and camping.
places.reason: 2 counted sources, 2118 page views

places.name: Dharnya Centre
places.coordinates_source: none yet: pin needed from a named visitor point (resolve-pin.py)
places.bio_draft: Yorta Yorta cultural and environmental interpretation centre inside Barmah National Park.
places.reason: Parks Victoria and Visit Echuca Moama list the Yorta Yorta cultural centre in Barmah National Park with guided cultural experiences and walks. Objection: hours uncertain, check dharnyacentre.com.au.

places.name: Kyabram Fauna Park
places.bio_draft: Goulburn Valley wildlife park at Kyabram with native animals.
places.reason: Wikivoyage Shepparton (opened) says worth a visit; Zoos Victoria runs it with 600 animals on 55 ha; a full-day wildlife visit.

places.name: Terrick Terrick National Park
places.bio_draft: Small box-ironbark park near Pyramid Hill, with walking tracks and camping.
places.reason: Parks Victoria and Bendigo Region tourism list the park with walks, birdwatching (Plains-wanderer), picnic and camping; a national park, own place. Objection: remote and thin facilities.

places.name: Murray-Sunset National Park
places.bio_draft: Victoria's largest national park, remote mallee country for 4WD, birdwatching, camping and stargazing.
places.reason: 2 counted sources, 2541 page views
places.standalone_reason: Standalone: ~71 km from Mildura, outside its reach; one national park with only Pink Lakes inside it, so not a destination (needs 4 spots).

places.name: Pink Lakes
places.coordinates_source: none yet: pin needed from a named visitor point (resolve-pin.py)
places.bio_draft: Pink-hued salt lakes inside Murray-Sunset National Park, a favourite with photographers.
places.reason: Visitor guide names the pink salt lakes as a photography draw within Murray-Sunset; a distinct named sight that guides single out.
places.standalone_reason: Standalone: inside Murray-Sunset but a distinct sight; ~70 km from Mildura. Not a destination (park plus one spot).

places.name: Hattah-Kulkyne National Park
places.bio_draft: Chain of Murray lakes, river red gums and bush tracks with camping, near Mildura.
places.reason: Parks Victoria page (opened) names it: lakes chain, river and bush tracks; a national park is a visit in itself and one agency source is enough for an obvious draw.
places.standalone_reason: Standalone: ~59 km from Mildura, beyond its ~45 km reach; a park with one spot cannot be a destination.

places.name: Wyperfeld National Park
places.bio_draft: Victoria's first national park, mallee bushland with walks and camping, reached from Hopetoun.
places.reason: Parks Victoria page names Victoria's first national park with walks and camping; obvious draw for a national park.
places.standalone_reason: Standalone: ~150 km from Mildura and far from any base; lone park.

places.name: Lake Tyrrell
places.bio_draft: Intermittent salt lake near Sea Lake with a mirror-like surface that draws photographers.
places.reason: Visit Grampians (opened) and Wimmera Mallee tourism pages name Victoria's largest salt lake, with viewing platform and boardwalk; 10,718 views.
places.standalone_reason: Standalone: ~66 km from Swan Hill and reached via Sea Lake; Swan Hill itself is not a destination (3 spots).

places.name: Gunbower National Park
places.bio_draft: River red gum forest on the Murray with bend camping areas for four wheel driving and camping.
places.reason: Parks Victoria names the river red gum forest with bend campsites and 4WD tracks; national park.
places.standalone_reason: Standalone: ~70 km from Echuca, beyond its ~60 km reach; reached from Cohuna and Gunbower.

places.name: Pioneer Settlement
places.bio_draft: Living history museum of 1850s cottages, horse-drawn carriages and a river cruise on the Murray at Swan Hill.
places.reason: Wikivoyage Swan Hill (opened) lists the 1850s living-history museum with river cruises; full visit.
places.standalone_reason: No destination covers it: its nearest base (Swan Hill, Shepparton, Rutherglen, Yarrawonga) has fewer than four kept spots, so it stands alone.

places.name: Swan Hill River Walk
places.coordinates_source: osm trail midpoint (1.0 km, nominatim): Swan Hill River Walk (MEDIUM)
places.bio_draft: 4.5 km riverside walk along the Murray from the Pump Station past the town's attractions.
places.reason: Wikivoyage Swan Hill: free 4.5 km riverside walk of about two hours passing the town's attractions; also Melbourne Playgrounds listing. Objection: overlaps Riverside Park and Pioneer Settlement.
places.standalone_reason: No destination covers it: its nearest base (Swan Hill, Shepparton, Rutherglen, Yarrawonga) has fewer than four kept spots, so it stands alone.

places.name: Lake Boga Flying Boat Museum
places.coordinates_source: osm tourism=museum (nominatim): Lake Boga Flying Boat Museum (HIGH)
places.bio_draft: Restored Catalina flying boat and wartime exhibits at the former RAAF depot, 16 km from Swan Hill.
places.reason: Wikivoyage Swan Hill (opened) lists the restored Catalina and WWII depot, A$18, open daily; a real visit.
places.standalone_reason: No destination covers it: its nearest base (Swan Hill, Shepparton, Rutherglen, Yarrawonga) has fewer than four kept spots, so it stands alone.

places.name: Shepparton Art Museum
places.bio_draft: Regional gallery in Shepparton with Australian and contemporary art.
places.reason: Regional art museum with a major contemporary and ceramics collection, a new building, named by Zoos Victoria and tourism sources; Wikivoyage Shepparton was re-checked and the museum is a Shepparton headline.
places.standalone_reason: No destination covers it: its nearest base (Swan Hill, Shepparton, Rutherglen, Yarrawonga) has fewer than four kept spots, so it stands alone.

places.name: KidsTown
places.bio_draft: Children's adventure playground between Shepparton and Mooroopna, entry by donation.
places.reason: Wikivoyage Shepparton and guides describe a very large free adventure playground open nearly every day (about 150,000 visitors a year); a family draw for an hour or more.
places.standalone_reason: No destination covers it: its nearest base (Swan Hill, Shepparton, Rutherglen, Yarrawonga) has fewer than four kept spots, so it stands alone.

places.name: Rutherglen Loops
places.coordinates_source: none yet: pin needed from a named visitor point (resolve-pin.py)
places.bio_draft: 48 km of linked cycling trails joining Rutherglen cellar doors, the Murray and Lake Moodemere.
places.reason: Explore Rutherglen (tourism board) and Australian Traveller list the 48 km network of walking and cycling loops linking cellar doors and Lake Moodemere; a named trail.
places.standalone_reason: No destination covers it: its nearest base (Swan Hill, Shepparton, Rutherglen, Yarrawonga) has fewer than four kept spots, so it stands alone.

places.name: Lake Mulwala
places.bio_draft: Murray reservoir at Yarrawonga and Mulwala used for boating, water sports and fishing.
places.reason: Yarrawonga Mulwala tourism board has Lake Mulwala pages: cruises (PS Cumberoona, Paradise Queen), 4.2 km foreshore walk, Chinaman's Island wetlands walk, swimming and fishing. Counted source found; the lake is the place.
places.standalone_reason: No destination covers it: its nearest base (Swan Hill, Shepparton, Rutherglen, Yarrawonga) has fewer than four kept spots, so it stands alone.

standalone_near_destination_notes.Kyabram Fauna Park: Made an Echuca spot (~34 km, nearer than Barmah and Terrick Terrick) rather than left orphaned; equally near Shepparton, which is not a destination.
standalone_near_destination_notes.Gunbower National Park: ~70 km from Echuca, beyond its reach; reached from Cohuna/Gunbower, so standalone.
standalone_near_destination_notes.Shepparton Art Museum / KidsTown: ~33 km from Echuca centre but in Shepparton city, not reached from Echuca; Shepparton has only 2 kept spots near it (3 with Kyabram, which went to Echuca).
standalone_near_destination_notes.Hattah-Kulkyne National Park: ~59 km from Mildura, beyond its ~45 km reach; standalone.

dropped_as_destination_duplicate.name: Swan Hill
dropped_as_destination_duplicate.reason: town is a wrapper beside Pioneer Settlement/River Walk; no destination (3 spots) so not placed as a spot.

dropped_as_destination_duplicate.name: Shepparton
dropped_as_destination_duplicate.reason: town is a wrapper beside Shepparton Art Museum/KidsTown; no destination (2 spots), not placed.

review_list.name: Swan Hill Regional Art Gallery
review_list.case: Wikivoyage and Visit the Murray list it (naive art collection), but Visit the Murray says it is under redevelopment with a smaller display in the library; unclear if a visitable gallery now.

review_list.name: Shepparton Communication Tower
review_list.case: Wikivoyage and a Visit Shepparton listing name the free observation deck (160 steps), but a Country News report says it was closed for window repairs and listed hours conflict; open status unverified.

review_list.name: Muscat Mile De Bortoli Rutherglen Estate
review_list.case: Explore Rutherglen and RACV name the 1886 Seppelt cellar building and Muscat Mile tasting. For: heritage building, signature regional experience. Against: a single cellar door within a wine region, not a distinct draw.

review_list.name: Pfeiffer Wines
review_list.case: Explore Rutherglen, Visit Victoria and RACV list the cellar door, muscat blending and Muscat Mile cask tour. For: tourism-named experience. Against: an individual winery among many.

notes: Swan Hill (Pioneer Settlement, River Walk, Lake Boga: 3 spots) and Shepparton (SAM, KidsTown: 2) stay standalone under the four-spot rule; owner may want Swan Hill as a destination (66 km span would also reach Lake Tyrrell). Pins provisional from candidates; Pink Lakes, Dharnya Centre, Port of Echuca, Rutherglen Loops have no coordinates (needs_pin). Spots carry no hours; cost/ticketUrl need research. Rutherglen wine places are in review list.

crossregion_decisions.reason: Moving existing NSW spots wentworth, old-wentworth-gaol, perry-sandhills under Mildura changes existing data across a state line: owner decision, not applied.
